spanish: Y tú, cuando te desviaste debajo de tu varón, y cuando te impureciste, y diere varón en ti su yacimiento aparte de tu varón,

findings.issue: כִּי is only a conjunction; «cuando» locks it as temporal and treats both clauses as events that occurred.
Qal sequential imperfect 3ms is rendered as future subjunctive «diere», shifting the coordinated clause into prospective mood.
H7903 with a 3ms suffix is his lying/copulation; «yacimiento» in current Spanish is a deposit or site.

notes: 2fs qatal and niphal match the preterites; את stays untranslated.
